theorem: For every integer h>=1 and every integer 1<=m<=256, F_144(h)<=F_m(h), under the stated raw-mask model.
proof_type: Central all-length theorem formally verified in Lean 4.19.0, including standard native_decide finite evaluation; analytic/Python proofs remain for additional paper claims.

public_release_authorization.scope: The owner explicitly requested pushing this result to the next numbered folder of the existing GitHub collection.
public_release_authorization.original_protocol: Retained byte-for-byte as historical research provenance.
public_release_authorization.novelty: Unestablished; release does not assert priority or faster factorization.
public_release_authorization.lean_update: Owner explicitly requested Lean verification and a push to folder 04.

fresh_parent_replay.location: Isolated relocated copy of the publication files

independent_coverage.qualification: Competing upper bounds beyond h64 were not independently recomputed; lower bounds suffice for the optimum theorem.

reviews.mathematics: Independent worker accepted CRT classes, gaps, envelopes, sharp discrepancy, density gap and infinite tail; parent also reviewed them.
reviews.prior_art: Independent worker accepted attribution and qualified novelty wording; no claim that publication itself resolves novelty.
reviews.portability: Scripts resolve inputs relative to their own paths; tests also passed from an unrelated cwd. Linux/Python3.10 compatibility is documented; tested runtime was Python3.14.8.
reviews.formalization: Three worker lanes covered semantics, finite evaluation, and checker soundness. Parent rebuilt all nine published local modules in a relocated copy and audited final axioms.

paper.visual_qa: All seven pages rendered and inspected; final revised trust paragraph also re-rendered and inspected. Final TeX log has no overfull/underfull boxes or missing characters.
paper.metadata: LaTeX/hyperref and xdvipdfmx; no encryption, attachments, or document JavaScript. OpenAction is the ordinary initial page-fit destination.

scope: Synthetic finite residue sets; no arbitrary-input factoring API or deployed tests.
trust: Lean kernel and ordinary logical axioms, plus compiler/runtime evaluation through Lean.ofReduceBool for the three finite checks. Python verification of the additional tables and analytic review are separate.

resource_limits.applies_to: Original exhaustive Python verifiers only. Lean replay time and peak child RSS are recorded separately in lean/verification.json.

hash_convention: SHA256SUMS covers every package file except itself. Mathematical files match the earlier reviewed records; telemetry is variable and reflects the stated run.

previous_publication.proof_type: Analytic CRT envelope plus computer-assisted exact finite lemmas; not proof-assistant formalized.
previous_publication.note: Initial Python/analytic release; superseded by this explicitly authorized Lean formalization.
